rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for cybercrime as a general category.

example.english: Cybercrime is no small matter, so everyone needs to stay alert.
example.traditional: 網絡罪案唔係小事，大家都要提高警覺。

rows.note: Use this when referring to one individual cybercrime or case.

example.english: The police have just cracked a cybercrime case.
